Show HN: bananabread AI – Find what customers love and want from your products
items.summary: We recently launched an API that finds what people consistently love about a specific consumer product. Some of our first users reached out asking whether it could also find what people still want from the product. That’s what we're launching today. For example, reviews like "I love the taste, but I wish it had less sugar" tells you what's working well already and what you could improve. Give the API a brand + product name (only consumer goods work for now). It first searches for thousands of reviews per product across Amazon, TikTok, Reddit, YouTube, Instagram, Walmart, and other web sources.
